name: 바람개비 성벽
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: Wide rampart-top composition with a row of large wooden pinwheel mechanisms spinning slowly atop weathered fortress battlements. Cool teal moonlight catches each rotating blade while warm amber torch brackets glow along an iron safety railing below. Open lower-central foreground along the wall walkway, distant sky and drifting clouds beyond, mechanical fantasy detail, and creaking wooden gears, no people, no text, no UI.
